now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
now.text: Hiding in Madripoor, Sharon shelters Sam and Bucky, then follows them to New York to help stop the Flag Smashers.
cases: ST-084 The Attack on the GRC (The Falcon and the Winter Soldier)

changes.evidence: In the mid-credits scene of the finale (episode 6), Sharon receives a full pardon and rejoins the CIA, so the series leaves her reinstated, not on the run. Her secret Power Broker side is carried by the Raft handover.

owner_calls.question: Season 7 record (k14): the Coulson acting in season 7 is a Chronicom-built LMD with his memories, and the status is 'Deceased'. Should the file show the LMD as Coulson carrying on (Active), or keep 'Deceased' for the original?
options: Keep Deceased (original Coulson stays dead; LMD noted in text)
Change to Active (LMD Coulson treated as the continuing character)
owner_calls.evidence: The season 6 premiere opens a year after Coulson's death; the season 6 finale reveals a Chronicom tech-enhanced Coulson LMD, who acts throughout season 7. As it stands, a 'Deceased' status sits on a record where Coulson is active.

owner_calls.question: The Agent Carter One-Shot (k5) is set in 1946, one year after The First Avenger, but it comes after the Agent Carter season 2 record (k4, 1947 Los Angeles). Keep it there as the close of Peggy's SSR arc (Howard naming her co-head of S.H.I.E.L.D.), or move it before the season 2 record (and before or after the season 1 record, also 1946) to follow in-universe dates?
options: Move before the season 2 record (date order)
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia: the One-Shot takes place 'one year after the events of Captain America: The First Avenger' (category Films set in 1946); Agent Carter season 2 is set in 1947.
